intended_object: The uniformizer t = 1/X of the place at infinity of the rational function field k(X), viewed as an element of the valuation ring O_∞. This comes from the docstrings of `tA` and `tRatFunc`, and from its use in `maximalIdeal_infty_eq_span_t`.
explanation: The body pairs `tRatFunc k = 1 / RatFunc.X` with a proof that it lies in `(RatFunc.inftyValuation k).valuationSubring`. The proof uses the fact that the valuation at infinity of X⁻¹ is exp(−1), which is at most 1. This is exactly the element 1/X of O_∞. The library then proves that it generates the maximal ideal, so it is a uniformizer. It is a specific element of a specific ring, so it is not too narrow; it only needs a field k. Mathlib has no definition of this element in this subring.
